reviews.t: colors as described, longer curing time but no stickiness when dry
reviews.x: I like the colors of this set. They are just as described/pictured. I did a quick manicure for the purpose of trying the gel polishes out and they really worked well. They took about 90 secs to cure under the UV light for each coat (base, color, top) but at the end, they were completely dry without any stickiness or the need to wipe them. They have a resin odor to them but it is not overly strong. Overall, this is a nice set.

My girlfriend has many gel nail polish, but this new set she says is her favorite, especially the green-lime color. The set also has other 7 different colors which are beautiful and rare as well. The gel works as supposed to. The brushes inside the bottles are nice and have good quality. So far so good. I will update my review if the quality decreases depending on the days used like shown on this picture. Happy customer!!

The colors are vibrant, I love that you can use one coat of this gel and it’s opaque but has that milky look to it. I used two coats here and the payoff was great.

reviews.t: Infinity Fall brown is more of a red poop color

It does have a lil sheerness but if you apply a tick layer you will be fine super easy to use ... but my concern was the top coat it was a lil Lumpy as you can see if ya can see on the pictures it’s was like sugar Particles in it but Besides that they are good.

Amazing!!  The only set I could find where I would use every color!!  Thickness is just the right about for 2 color coats. No wipe necessary. I will definitely order again from this brand! Especially if they offer color sets as good as this one.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the colors, especially the greens, describing them as beautiful, vibrant, and accurate to the pictures.
Many customers find the polish easy to apply and say it works well and lasts.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with the polish peeling or chipping quickly.
Several reviewers note longer curing times than expected, needing extra time under the UV lamp to fully harden.
Customers appreciate that the set includes base and top coat and comes in nice gift packaging.
